chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from 'Asim ibn Humayd, who said:
I asked him about the dead person: if a human touches him, is there ghusl upon him? He said: He said, “If you touch his body when it has become cold, then perform ghusl.”

key_terms.غُسْلٌ: ritual bath required after a specified cause

ai.seo_question: Does touching a dead body require ghusl in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning touching the body of a deceased person. It states that if one touches the body after it has become cold, ghusl becomes obligatory.
